pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: features/labs/rentgen/getTerminalData.ts:80 The context's only I/O is a once-per-render read of the in-process embedded store. On failure it makes one caught attempt, reports it through reportLoaderFailure and degrades that layer to empty. Nothing is ever retried, so the subject's precondition does not hold: a case-insensitive grep of features/labs/rentgen/ for retry|retries|backoff|jitter|circuit|breaker|setInterval|attempt|setTimeout found no hits.

pairs.subject: retry-backoff
pairs.evidence: features/admin/loops/loopState.ts:465 The admin surface only reads persisted ingest-run records, local files and the store. It reports failed runs as a failure-streak alert and gives operators a hand-confirmed 'requeue' journal verb, but it never issues or retries a failing call itself. A case-insensitive grep of features/admin/ for retry|retries|backoff|jitter|circuit|breaker|attempt|setInterval|setTimeout found no hits, so there is no retry ladder here to judge.
